There was a boy named Han Gun-mo. He was from Korea, but he lived in America.
Gun-mo did not speak English. His parents could not speak English well. He spoke only Korean.
Still, he had to go to school. In school, his teachers spoke English. His classmates spoke English, too.
Poor Gun-mo was very unhappy. He could not talk to people. He could not understand them, either.
After one month, Gun-mo met a new friend. His name was James. James wanted to learn Korean. Gun-mo wanted to learn English.
Every day, they met. James taught Gun-mo English, and Gun-mo taught James Korean.
Three months later, they could talk together. The teachers were very amazed.
Gun-mo made many new friends. He was happy in America, thanks to James.
